subject: Monitoring renewal coordination and multi-vendor pricing plan
messages:
From: Sarah Patel <sarah@datadog.com>
To: ava_chen@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Upcoming renewals — Datadog + coordination with Grafana/Sentry

Hi Ava,

Quick note that your Datadog contract is up for renewal on 2026-11-15. We ran the usage forecast attached and included a consolidated pricing sheet for logs, APM, and the retention add-on. Given your current ingestion and retention footprint the two levers with the biggest impact are (1) retention tier for logs and (2) committed throughput for APM.

Attachments: vendor_pricing_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

If it helps, I can hold the current price for 30 days while your procurement team does the procurement loop. Also looping in Lucas (Grafana Cloud) and Alba (Sentry) for a single lock-step negotiation — it often helps to coordinate cross-vendor timing so you can evaluate bundled credits and offset.

Can we set a 30-minute call early next week to run the numbers with your cost model?

Thanks,
Sarah
Datadog — Strategic Accounts
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah@datadog.com>, Lucas Meyer <lucas@grafana.com>, Alba Ruiz <alba@sentry.io>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewals — Datadog + coordination with Grafana/Sentry

Thanks Sarah — and thanks for looping everyone.

Marcus and Mina: Sarah attached a vendor pricing matrix and a usage forecast. Our renewal window is tight and we want to:
- Avoid a cliff for logs retention (we hit SLOs on historical traces)
- Explore committed tiers for Grafana Cloud to reduce monthly run-rate
- Push Sentry on a rate-limit / volume guardrail for errors to reduce overage risk

Proposed next steps:
1) Marcus to run a quick retention cost sensitivity (3/6/12 months) with the latest production ingestion numbers.
2) Procurement (Ben) to confirm contracting SLAs we need (SOC 2, data residency, egress).
3) Parallel outreach to Grafana & Sentry to get comparable term windows so we can ask for cross-vendor considerations.

I can host a 30-min sync Monday 2026-10-05 10:00 PDT — works for internal stakeholders, confirm if external partners can make it.

Attachment: monitoring_renewal_summary.pdf (pdf) — short internal one-pager.

Best,
Ava Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: ava_chen@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewals — Datadog + coordination with Grafana/Sentry

Ava — quick pass on numbers attached.

Summary:
- If we keep current retention at 90 days in Datadog, projected incremental cost next year ~ $220k. Dropping to 30 days saves ~ $160k but increases risk for debugging multi-week incidents.
- Grafana Cloud committed tier would save ~25% on dashboard/query costs for the same ingestion levels if we commit 12 months.
- Sentry overage exposure is small but spikes during incident windows; we should negotiate an incident forgiveness clause or a lower per-event price beyond the cap.

Attachments: retention_cost_model.xlsx (xlsx)

Action items I can take before Monday call:
- Produce a simple 3-scenario cost table (status-quo / moderate retention cut / aggressive retention cut) — will attach by EOD Sunday.
- Recommend a conservative blended target to present to vendors (targeting $120k run-rate reduction annualized).

Marcus
Senior Infrastructure PM, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: ava_chen@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement checklist & contract constraints

Ava / team — reviewing the materials. High level notes from procurement/legal: 
- We require SOC 2 Type II evidence and the latest penetration test report for any vendor storing telemetry.
- Data retention & egress: we need explicit clauses about how long vendor retains raw logs and an SLA about export time if we request bulk export.
- Term/auto-renewal: prefer a 12-month committed term with 60-day notice for renewal. If vendor insists on auto-renew, we need a pricing hold for 30 days post-renewal to run a reprocurement.

I'll draft a procurement checklist and proposed redlines — attaching the template. For the internal finance ask, I need a recommended one-year cost delta (status-quo vs proposed) to include in the PR. Marcus, the retention_cost_model.xlsx you attached will work for that.

Attachments: procurement_checklist.docx (docx)

Ben Carter
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah@datadog.com>, Lucas Meyer <lucas@grafana.com>, Alba Ruiz <alba@sentry.io>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewals — Datadog + coordination with Grafana/Sentry — next steps

Thanks all — summary and asks below so we have a clear agenda for the Monday sync and for vendor follow-ups.

Summary of internal position:
- Target annualized run-rate reduction: $120k (blended across monitoring stack).
- Retention: willing to move to a 60-day retention default if vendors can guarantee a 14-day export SLA for bulk historical searches; aggressive 30-day move only if we get incident/forgiveness protections.
- Commit length: prefer 12 months for Grafana if we get a 20–25% discount; Datadog can propose either a 12-month committed credit or a 6-month trial with pricing hold.
- Sentry: request a 30-day incident forgiveness buffer and ask for a capped overage rate (max 1.5x listed per-event price).

Asks to vendors before Monday call:
1) Datadog (Sarah) — please provide a 30-day price hold confirmation in writing and a draft clause for a retention export SLA.
2) Grafana (Lucas) — pricing for a 12-month committed tier at our current ingestion profile + any marketplace credits you can layer.
3) Sentry (Alba) — proposed overage cap language and whether you can provide a 30-day volume forgiveness for incidents.

Internal asks:
- Ben: hold a draft of the minimal contractual redlines (SOC2 evidence, export SLA, notice windows).
- Marcus: finalize the 3-scenario cost table and mark the recommended conservative target (I think $120k is reasonable for negotiation).
- Mina: prepare the impact note for Engineering on search/debug tradeoffs if we reduce retention.

I'll open a brief follow-up calendar invite for Monday 2026-10-05 10:00 PDT. If vendors can't make that slot, propose alternatives and we'll re-run.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
